grade9v3:question_repairs.pattern: In this end-on reference the carbonyl direction stays fixed; the donor direction rotates by the declared 45 degrees while connectivity and 18 valence/24 total electrons stay fixed. grade9v3:question_repairs.check: Counterfactual: remove the word hybridisation while retaining changed orientation; the mechanistic statement survives.
grade9v3:question_repairs.probe: If two sketches have the same label but different donor alignment, must their donation be identical? If the label changes alone, has a mechanism been supplied?
grade9v3:question_repairs.pattern: Neither follows. Persistent label-only explanations expose causal substitution.

grade9v3:question_repairs.rule: Given factors at 0,60,90 degrees are 1,1/2,0. Both cosine and cosine-squared are even. A degenerate two-orbital Hamiltonian with coupling t0 cos(theta) gives epsilon ± |t0 cos(theta)|, so no universal cosine-squared total-energy law follows.

teaching_path.action: Evaluate the supplied overlap factor at the three angles.
teaching_path.why_valid: The stated model is cos(theta); cos(0)=1, cos(60)=1/2 and cos(90)=0.

Compare theta = 0, 60 and 90 degrees, then assess the claim that the molecule's total energy must therefore vary as cos(theta). Separate execution of the given model from a justified claim about the physical system.

teaching_path.action: Identify the missing link from overlap to total energy.
teaching_path.why_valid: An overlap factor is not a Hamiltonian and supplies no full energy budget.
inputs: Factors: 1, 1/2, 0.

teaching_path.action: Construct an explicit counterexample to uniqueness.

teaching_path.action: Bound even alternative energy approximations.
teaching_path.why_valid: A squared-interaction estimate needs stated weak-coupling assumptions; a degenerate two-level coupling can instead yield epsilon plus/minus absolute t.
inputs: Same overlap, different total energy; proportionality is not implied.

microtopics.badge_reason: Requires reconciling local electron-domain counting with adjacent pi conjugation driving rehybridisation.
entry_assumptions: Can determine local Lewis structures and count electron domains.
Understands resonance stabilization in introductory conjugated systems.
microtopics.inferential_jump: Approximately planar amide N can use an introductory sp2-like sigma framework plus an aligned p-like lone-pair donor. Four Lewis entries do not override the supplied delocalised-model conditions; the basis is not unique observed reality.

teaching_path.action: Record the Lewis inventory and the supplied donation condition separately.
teaching_path.why_valid: N has three bonds plus a lone pair, but the task also supplies approximately planar donation into an adjacent carbonyl pi system.
inputs: In formamide, H–C(=O)–NH2, a local Lewis count gives nitrogen three sigma bonds and a lone pair. You are also given that the approximately planar amide arrangement permits nitrogen-lone-pair donation into the adjacent carbonyl pi system, which requires a suitably aligned p-like orbital. Choose a model that accounts for both the sigma framework and delocalisation. Resolve the apparent conflict with an automatic 'four domains therefore sp3' label and state the limits of your chosen hybridisation description.
teaching_path.output: A four-entry Lewis ledger does not settle the electronic model.

teaching_path.action: Choose a basis that represents both jobs.

inputs: A four-entry Lewis ledger does not settle the electronic model.
teaching_path.output: A planar sigma framework plus a p-like donor connected to the carbonyl pi space.

teaching_path.action: Compare the supplied angles with their shared introductory label.
teaching_path.why_valid: CH4, NH3 and H2O use sp3-like descriptions but have different lone-pair counts and nuclear shapes.
inputs: A student claims: 'Hybridisation uniquely determines bond angles and any deviation proves the hybridisation label wrong.' The benchmark supplies approximate observations: CH4 tetrahedral about 109.5 degrees; NH3 pyramidal about 107 degrees; H2O bent about 104.5 degrees; all three commonly use an introductory sp3 description at the central atom. It also supplies approximately planar amide nitrogen with lone-pair delocalisation. Construct and test a qualified replacement claim using these observations, local domain counting, lone-pair effects and the amide boundary case. State what further evidence would be needed before treating a qualitative orbital picture as a unique physical account.
teaching_path.output: 109.5, about 107 and about 104.5 degrees are compatible with the supplied shared label.

teaching_path.action: Reject the unique-angle implication.
teaching_path.why_valid: A single model label does not fix all interactions that affect geometry.
inputs: 109.5, about 107 and about 104.5 degrees are compatible with the supplied shared label.
teaching_path.output: Angle deviations alone do not falsify every sp3-like description.

teaching_path.action: Specify evidence needed for stronger physical claims.
teaching_path.why_valid: Nuclear geometry alone does not uniquely recover wavefunctions or a hybrid decomposition.
inputs: Local counts guide a bounded starting model; lone pairs, alignment and delocalisation require additional checks.
teaching_path.output: Use defined spectroscopic/electronic-structure evidence and model assumptions; retain alternative compatible descriptions.

question_families.title: Chemical Bonding, Orbital Alignment and Hybridisation Models
solution_structure: Inspect adjacent atoms for unhybridised p orbitals or pi systems.
Evaluate geometric and conformational feasibility of orbital overlap.
Assign appropriate hybridisation and delocalisation models with model boundaries.

demand_dimensions.model_choice: Choose between localized sp3, planar sp2 with unhybridised p, or orthogonal pi models.
demand_dimensions.representation_translation: Translate verbal formulas and conformations into 3D orbital alignments and nodal planes.
demand_dimensions.reasoning_steps: Local count, adjacency check, overlap symmetry evaluation, energy and model boundary check.
demand_dimensions.novelty: Amide delocalisation, 90-degree torsional decoupling, methyl radical SOMO, and allene orthogonal pi bonds.

safe_variations: Change substituents while preserving the same orbital alignment and conjugation conditions.
transfer_boundaries: Do not equate spatial proximity with through-bond conjugation.
Do not treat hybridisation as a physical cause of bond angles or reactivity.
common_wrong_routes: Apply four domains therefore sp3 automatically without checking adjacent pi systems.
Assume twisting breaks formal electron counts or chemical connectivity.
